[4:31PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic from CMS Bridge descending towards Offin Canal Market and continuing to Ijora Olopa via the NEPA intersection is flowing well.
Broad Street through to Apongbon, underneath the bridge towards Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, is also clear.

Movement on Eko Bridge inward Apongbon, connecting to CMS proper, Elegbeta, Leventis, and through the UBA Roundabout to both Inner and Outer Marina, is equally free-flowing.
Currently, there are no impediments, and traffic personnel are on ground monitoring the situation.

#FollowLASTMA
